title: Happy path
description: Payment authorizes and inventory reserves. The corrected design captures and completes; the uncorrected design has no capture step and is stranded in FULFILLING (L1).

title: Stock leak on payment failure
description: Inventory reserves, then payment fails and the order is cancelled. The corrected design releases the reservation; the uncorrected design leaks it (I4).

title: Held authorization on inventory failure
description: Payment authorizes, then inventory fails and the order is cancelled. The corrected design voids the authorization; the uncorrected design leaves it live (I5).

title: Duplicate delivery double-reserves
description: A re-delivered ORDER_APPROVED reaches inventory. The corrected design deduplicates by eventId; the uncorrected design (offset-keyed) reserves twice (I7).
